# AnimaScript API reference

<!-- GENERATED by docsgen/gen_as_api.py -->

Every type and function a `.as` script can import from
`rive/*`, as the std declares them, bodies dropped. Each
page is one module: `import { Path } from "rive/path";`
brings in what [path.md](path.md) lists.

See [../protocols.md](../protocols.md) for how a script is
structured and attached to a scene.
